text:
leah_fin: FYI invoice 2026-9999 from Evripides Ltd (CY) came in flagged. Vendor requests net payment and asks Redwood to gross-up for any US withholding. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood.com/2026-9999.pdf

invoice-bot: Invoice 2026-9999 flagged: VAT ID present (CY12345678), missing TRC and gross-up addendum. Status: REVIEW_REQUIRED :warning:

giorgos_vendor: hi team 6 we're a Cyprus LTD (VAT CY12345678). this is a one-off dev + IP delivery. contract clause 9 says vendor to be "made whole" for withholding. we believe the US-Cyprus treaty should reduce withholding to 0% on royalties. happy to provide TRC and anything else.

yasmin_tax: quick clarifier: is this invoiced as royalties or service fees? US source vs foreign source matters. If it's a transfer of IP with royalties sourced to the US, treaty may apply with TRC. If it's a service performed outside US, likely no US withholding.

leah_fin: vendor labels it "license + deliverable" on invoice. legal and tax need to classify. finance will hold payment until we get residency docs and legal confirms contract language.

peter_legal: contract language is a little fuzzy. "made whole" is present but no formula. Legal needs a signed gross-up addendum that defines calculation. we'll ask vendor to sign standardized addendum.

giorgos_vendor: uploaded TRC_CY_2026-9999.pdf and Bank_IBAN_****6789.pdf

invoice-bot: New files uploaded: TRC_CY_2026-9999.pdf, Bank_IBAN_****6789.pdf by giorgos_vendor

yasmin_tax: received TRC. next step: confirm whether payment is royalties (tax code) vs service. If royalties & treaty applies, US withholding can be reduced per treaty (often 0% for certain royalties) but TRC + signed declaration (and sometimes W-8BEN-E claiming treaty benefits) required. If it's service income not sourced to US, withholding may not apply.

leah_fin: action items summarized: (1) legal to confirm classification as royalty vs service (2) tax to confirm treaty applicability and exact rate if royalty (3) vendor to sign gross-up addendum if they require gross-up (4) finance holds payment pending outcomes.

peter_legal: i'll draft addendum and ask vendor to sign. also checking whether local VAT/reverse-charge applies in EU since vendor included VAT line. if reverse-charge applies, we shouldn't pay VAT.

giorgos_vendor: we included VAT erroneously; sorry. EVR will reissue without VAT if reverse-charge expected. will sign addendum if needed.

invoice-bot: Payment status changed: PENDING_REVIEW -> ON_HOLD by leah_fin

yasmin_tax: offline note: preliminary view is treaty may apply if royalties are US-source and beneficial owner is Cyprus resident. With TRC + W-8BEN-E claiming treaty, withholding could be 0%. If payment is for services performed entirely outside US and not US-source, no US withholding. Tax to confirm after legal classification.

leah_fin: finance won't gross-up automatically. if legal confirms contract requires gross-up and vendor signs addendum, finance needs explicit GL approval for any gross-up amount. tagging @finance-approvals.

giorgos_vendor: reissued invoice without VAT and uploaded Grossup_Addendum_signed_2026-9999.pdf

invoice-bot: New file uploaded: Invoice_2026-9999_noVAT.pdf, Grossup_Addendum_signed_2026-9999.pdf by giorgos_vendor

yasmin_tax: tax ops final note: because TRC is provided and vendor signed W-8BEN-E claiming treaty benefits, and legal confirmed the line is royalty for IP transfer, treaty reduces withholding to 0% for this royalty category. No withholding required. Condition: keep TRC + W-8BEN-E on file.

leah_fin: thanks tax/legal. releasing payment and marking invoice as CLEARED. finance still requires addendum and TRC in case of audit.

peter_legal: noted — will file executed addendum copy in contract folder.

giorgos_vendor: thanks team  glad we sorted it. let us know if anything else needed.

invoice-bot: Thread note: "TRC + W-8BEN-E received, addendum signed, payment released per tax/legal; no US withholding due. Files attached."
